subject: EU processing assurances & VPC SOW coordination for MedSight
messages:
From: Claire Dupont <claire@medsight.fr>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsight.fr
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Request: EU-only processing assurances + VPC deployment SOW

Hello Laura,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. MedSight is evaluating Redwood to host PHI-derived inference for our telehealth triage workflows. Before we move to a POC, procurement and legal need: 1) an explicit "EU-only" processing guarantee (data and model hosting restricted to EU regions), 2) a redeployable VPC pattern (we can host in our cloud tenant) or a private deployment option, and 3) copies of recent SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ outputs and any DPIA support you can provide.

We also need a short SOW template that includes the regional-processing language and acceptance criteria so we can circulate internally. Our procurement timeline is tight: PO targeted by 2027-05-20.

I attached our DPIA template to show the level of detail they'll expect. Can you confirm what evidence you can deliver and an approximate timeline for the SOW + legal language?

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dupont
Head of Procurement, MedSight Health

Attachment: MedSight_DPIA_Template.docx

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dupont <claire@medsight.fr>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only processing assurances + VPC deployment SOW

Hi Claire,

Thanks — received and useful context. Looping in KarThik (solutions) and Hannah (security/compliance) so we can collect the artifacts and draft the SOW language. High level: we support Private (VPC) deployments and EU region locking; we can provide SOC 2 Type II and a redacted SIG/CAIQ response, and we have a standard DPA that supports SCCs or EU Addendum language.

I'll coordinate a short kickoff call (30 min) to align on PO dates and any DPIA gaps. Is 2027-05-06 or 2027-05-07 morning CET possible for you?

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dupont <claire@medsight.fr>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only processing assurances + VPC deployment SOW

Claire — thanks for the DPIA template, helpful. Quick technical summary and what we can share immediately: 

- EU-only processing: Redwood Private can be provisioned in an EU cloud tenant or via our EU-hosted dedicated pools with region-lock routing. We can include contract language that all customer data, model checkpoints, and inference logs for this project will be stored and processed only in EU regions specified in the SOW.

- VPC deployment pattern: we have a VPC connector pattern with private peering, customer-managed NAT, and optional HSM/KMS integration for customer-controlled keys. I attached our deployment playbook which includes network diagrams and an ops runbook.

- Evidence: we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a completed CAIQ/SIG extract for the controls relevant to data residency and network isolation. For DPIA support, we offer a 2-hour workshop with our compliance lead and a short write-up of mitigations we recommend.

Proposed next steps:
1) I will attach a draft SOW section for "Regional Processing & VPC" by EOD tomorrow.
2) Security will circulate the redact SOC 2 and a SIG snippet once legal signs an NDA/receiver agreement.
3) Schedule the DPIA workshop (30–60 min) week of 2027-05-10.

Let me know if we should call out encryption-at-rest keys being customer managed in the SOW.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Deployment_Playbook.pdf, Redwood_SCCs_Annex.txt

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dupont <claire@medsight.fr>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T10:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only processing assurances + VPC deployment SOW

Hi Claire — adding some specifics from security/legal: 

1) Evidence we can provide now (redacted):
   - Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (control narratives and test results relevant to change management, logical access, and availability)
   - Redwood_SCCs_Annex.txt (we can execute SCCs; annex references and version included)
   - A CAIQ/SIG extract focused on Data Protection & Infrastructure controls (we will redact ops-sensitive details).

2) DPA and attestation: we can provide our standard DPA which includes SCCs or EU Addendum language. For customers who require an attestation letter stating "EU-only processing" for a specific workload, we produce a one-page processing attestation (customer + project specific) that is signed by our Head of Legal. Typical turnaround for a reviewed attestation is ~10 business days after we receive the SOW and the exact region identifiers.

3) DPIA support: we're happy to run the workshop. Security will provide a short mitigation memo afterwards that you can include in your DPIA appendix.

4) Key controls to call out in SOW: region-locking policy, VPC isolation, customer-managed encryption keys (optional), no replication outside EU for backups (or explicit retention/replication language if required).

I attached the redacted SOC 2 and SCCs annex. For full SIG/CAIQ we require a signed mutual NDA; happy to route that to your legal contact.

From: Claire Dupont <claire@medsight.fr>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-05T17:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only processing assurances + VPC deployment SOW

Thanks everyone — this is helpful and moves us forward. A few clarifications before I share with legal: 

- Can you confirm the exact EU regions you would put on the SOW (we need datacenter/region IDs for our DPIA appendix)?
- For the attestation: we need the EU-only processing sentence included verbatim in the SOW AND a separate signed attestation letter referencing the project name and SOW id. Is 10 business days acceptable if we sign the SOW by 2027-05-07?
- Please confirm whether "no replication outside EU" is a default or requires explicit configuration and any costs/ops needed.

Procurement will issue PO #MS-2027-049 as soon as the SOW includes the regional-processing clause. I attached the PO stub.

Can we book the DPIA workshop for 2027-05-11 at 14:00 CET? If that works, please send a calendar invite including the outline you mentioned.

Best regards,
Claire

Attachment: PO_MS-2027-049.pdf
